title: ID0461920-DC/Si-D/BR-[MP / R4 170001785] OCPP does not show meter data
description:
Reported behavior/issue:  OCPP does not show meter data
Solution: Yes. ( Did soft reset and the charger is working)
yyyy-mm-dd: 2025- 11-17

additional_info.subject: OCPP Issue with Sicharge
additional_info.body:
Hello we are having issues with missing packets from OCPP,
the issue is, when a user starts a transaction, no MeterValues are being sent back to the OCP,
we need help enabling all meter values to be sent back to us via OCPP.
Here is the info on the charger:
v2.11.0-0-geeb1d66
ID Zxa4Mx

additional_info.subject: ID0461920-DC/Si-D/BR-[MP / R4 170001785] OCPP does not show meter data CRM:02888000401
additional_info.body:
Dear Mr. Angelo,
I hope you are doing well.
After checking you charger system we have find out that you are using a very old version of software (
v2.11.0-0-geeb1d66). If you give permission we can update it remotely to later version.
In this case you need to enable all MeterValues available with 30s frequency of update during the transaction cycle to shows meter data via OCPP.
Mit Freundlichen Grüßen/ Melhores Cumprimentos/ Best Regards
Harun Ar Rashid
Technical Support Specialist (eMobility)
Av. 25 de Abril 201, 2845-547, Amora, Portugal.
Email: harun.ar-rashid.ext@siemens.com
